newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Plutonic says aided by investments.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Plutonic says aided by investments.

text.p: Gold miner Plutonic Resources Ltd said on Thursday that gains on investments, a strong hedge book and corporate transactions helped it a record after tax profit in calendar 1996.

"Operating costs at our mines, other than the Plutonic and Peak Hill gold mine were too high," Plutonic managing director Ronald Hawkes said in a statement accompanying the company's full year results.
However, he said the year was overshadowed by the discovery of the large, high grade Darlot Centenary deposit last October.
The deposit near Plutonic's existing Darlot gold mine in Western Australia would provide the company with a second large, low cost cost mine for future growth, he said.
Plutonic is about 30 percent owned by Malaysia Mining Corp Bhd.
